kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the tables and the schematic; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The CYP450 polarity-pair reading of RIPE (rifampin induces while INH inhibits — opposite polarities co-prescribed) plus the partnerships system (pyridoxine, visual monitoring, uric acid, LFTs) and the four-door cell reading — KYP's synthesis of the regimen.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the rows without the polarity-pair or partnership framing; both are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + both mechanism captions + the exam callout + patterns + traps + pivots + mnemonics + miniCase

notes: Census: p214's only image is the decorative 1×1+smask color wash behind the line-art MYCOBACTERIAL CELL schematic (VLM-census confirmed); p215 pure text. Quirks documented: the 'CACTERIUM' header (MYCOB prefix lost in extraction); the schematic's rotated rim labels split mid-word with the figure emitting after the indd footer (raw 92-155); the source's own NOTES mnemonics ('INH Injures Neurons and Hepatocytes', 'Pronounce eyethambutol') carried ONLY inside the verbatim tables per the E38 precedent — omitted from the visual and the KYP memory layer; the C1-prefixed arrows on the mechanism rows (normalizer strips).
